meta.name: customer-success-management
meta.description: Runs the ongoing relationship with accounts after the sale — segmenting coverage against account value, building a health score that predicts rather than describes, running reviews customers find worth attending, forecasting renewals honestly, and finding expansion that follows usage instead of quota. Use this to design a customer success motion, decide who gets a named contact, work out why renewals surprise you, or fix a health score everyone ignores.

copy.tagline: 设计客户成功策略,让续约与扩张更可预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们常被续约结果惊到,健康分也没人看
copy.tagline_en: Design a customer success motion that predicts renewals and finds expansion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if renewals keep surprising you and your health score is ignored.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计客户成功管理：按账户价值划分覆盖层级、构建能预测流失的健康评分、组织客户愿意参加的复盘、如实预测续约并依据使用情况找扩张机会。
howto.when: 当你说出“客户成功”等词，或要求设计客户成功机制、排查续约意外时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个客户成功机制，把账户按价值分三层覆盖。
怎么建立能预测流失的健康评分？先看看去年流失客户有什么共同点。
say.note: 会引导你反向验证评分

say.text: 有个客户续约要到了，帮我按阶段跟踪续约进展。
say.note: 会把续约当作管线管理

howto.what_en: Claude will help you design a customer success motion: segment coverage by account value, build a churn-predicting health score, run reviews customers find worthwhile, forecast renewals honestly, and find expansion from usage patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'customer success' or ask to design a customer success motion, or to figure out why renewals surprised you.

say_en.text: Help me design a customer success motion, splitting accounts into three coverage tiers.
How to build a churn-predicting health score? Compare churned vs renewed accounts.
A renewal is coming; help me track it in stages like a pipeline.
